decision: Agents may use all valid task transitions; human post-DONE validation is a separate audit acknowledgement.
coverage: Agent plans READY, claims, attaches declared evidence, reviews, QA and DONE without human approvals.
Agent cancellation, reopening and return to implementation permitted; technical gates, scopes, versions and claims preserved.
Human-only post-DONE validation increments technical version and audit/outbox without changing state or work revision.
Validation idempotency, concurrency, audit rollback, append-only history, viewer/agent denial and work revision conflicts.
Reopening and new completion preserve prior validation as historical and permit a new validation.
Validation appears in REST/MCP task detail and consistent project context.
limitations: No commit or push of this change; formal evidence URL for ACC-LOCAL-017 remains pending publication, so its workflow state is IN_PROGRESS.
Synthetic UI acknowledgement is not human acceptance of this implementation.
One full integration run under load failed the exact rejection count in the existing 100-claim race; its isolated repeat and the final full 77-test run passed without weakening assertions.
